category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly reduce dropout to 0.2 and AdamW learning rate to 7e-4, while increasing weight decay to 1e-5. Lower dropout may retain more short-history signal; smaller updates and stronger weight decay may control overfitting. Preserve the HSTU architecture, features, tied embeddings, readout, loss, seeds and training limits. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading remain compatible.
